question: does RAGAS' default strictness of 3 change the score for this target?
method: Six cases spanning the observed range, re-scored against the committed strictness=1 values. strictness=3 is reached through RAGAS' sequential path (bypass_n), because the provider rejects n>1.
note: meropenem-tier scored 0.721 at strictness=3 in an earlier two-case run and 0.585 here, so the per-case figure is unstable; five of six cases move by less than 0.013.
